items.title: Abe Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: the people who recommended me were Manny Klein, they happened to know me, and I was in the Army with Manny Klein.

ctx.x: Dave Cavanaugh, who had started it, took exception to what the guy was saying, and he fired Gus and told this guy to leave and don’t come back. So they called me. Otherwise I never would have been — I have to mention that because I know he did it because he was closer to the people involved than I was. And the people who recommended me were Manny Klein, they happened to know me, and I was in the Army with Manny Klein. So that was one good thing from the Army. And I started doing all those. And what they did was…

Yeah, those little discoveries are quite interesting. After listening to it for so many years and then all of a sudden you finally say, oh, that’s how that’s done. That’s why it sounds the way it does.
